author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: domed head with long closed ear lobes hanging on both sides, a round nose, a short mouth and jowl curves; reads as a cocker spaniel face like the reference. The rejected drawing was an open arch with a blob nose.
omissions: The nose is a small ring (reads nearly solid) instead of a triangle; the wavy ear edges are smoothed.
drawing_plan: HRECT_L symmetric about x 24: outline beziers from ear feet (4,40)/(44,40) up to branch nodes (11,16)/(37,16) and over the dome (24,8); ear inner edges to jowl corners (13,36)/(35,36); ear feet curl to the corners; nose ring r2 at (24,26), mouth to (24,32), jowls to the corners.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'dog': dome head with hanging ears and a muzzle.
